# Don't Trust Anyone

> Free-to-play 3D rage-bait troll platformer in the browser with 47 solo levels, 15 2-player online co-op levels, deceptive traps, and zero downloads.

- Canonical URL: https://dta.inkfinitystudio.store/
- How to Play Guide: https://dta.inkfinitystudio.store/how-to-play
- Publisher: Inkfinity Studio (https://inkfinitystudio.store)
- Contact: support@inkfinitystudio.store

## Key Features & Benefits
- **100% Free & Zero Download**: Runs instantly in desktop and mobile web browsers (WebGL / Three.js) with no installation.
- **62 Handcrafted 3D Levels**: 47 Solo levels and 15 Couple Co-op levels across 5 themed worlds.
- **2-Player Online Co-op**: Create a private room, share a 9-digit room code or invite link, and play together with real-time sync, quick chat, and VIP voice chat.
- **Deceptive Troll Mechanics**: Fake win banners, fake checkpoints, disappearing floors, inverted controls, and hidden spikes.
- **8 Unlockable 3D Outfits**: Momo, Naruto, Gojo, Goku, Doraemon, Princess, Dumpling, and Fairy.
- **Cross-Device Controls**: Full keyboard support on desktop and an adaptive touch joystick on mobile.

## Core Rules
- **Solo Mode**: Guide Momo from the spawn platform to the exit door. Question every sign, floor, and checkpoint—the game actively tries to trick you.
- **2-Player Co-op Mode**: Shared-fate co-op. Both players must reach the exit door (collecting keys or defusing bombs when required) to clear a level. If either player dies, both players restart together.

## Modes & Worlds
1. **Candy Meadow** (Solo)
2. **Toy Factory** (Solo)
3. **Haunted Bakery** (Solo)
4. **Mind Games** (Solo)
5. **Couple Co-op** (2-Player Online Co-op, Levels 48–62)
